note: Per-theme art and audio direction. Colors are accents layered on the base palette in Style-guide.md. artNotes guide AI art generation for tiles and card backgrounds.

themes.name: Ruined Keep
themes.summary: Crumbling castle halls where goblins have moved in. The tutorial theme: warm torchlight, readable shapes.
themes.artNotes: Torch-lit grey stone, broken banners, moss in the cracks.

themes.name: Sewer Vermin
themes.summary: Flooded tunnels under the keep, thick with rats and green fog.
themes.artNotes: Dripping brick arches, murky water channels, sickly green fog pockets.

themes.name: Ash Foundry
themes.summary: An abandoned rune-forge where machines still run: conveyors, vents and lava channels.
themes.artNotes: Soot-black iron, glowing lava seams, brass gears and hissing vents.

themes.name: Catacombs
themes.summary: Bone-lined tunnels where the dead don't stay down.
themes.artNotes: Skull niches, bone piles, pale violet rune light.

themes.name: Cursed Chapel
themes.summary: A desecrated chapel where cultists chant and the floor whispers.
themes.artNotes: Cracked stained glass, purple sigils, toppled pews and tombstones.

themes.name: Blood Arena
themes.summary: A gladiator pit run by orcs, ringed by chasms and iron bars.
themes.artNotes: Red sand, iron cages, crimson vines; stylized, never gory.

themes.name: Rotwood
themes.summary: A sunken forest of roots, spiders and illusions.
themes.artNotes: Twisted roots, glowing fungus, webs, fog between thorn walls.

themes.name: Mirror Halls
themes.summary: The final labyrinth: mirrored halls that remix every danger the hero has faced.
themes.artNotes: Polished obsidian, mirrors reflecting earlier themes, floating runes.
themes.audioMood: Shimmering, layered reprise of earlier themes.
